en-US.title: MenoCompass: Menopause Tracker
en-US.subtitle: Perimenopause Symptom Log
en-US.description:
Make menopause and perimenopause easier to track—and easier to explain.

MenoCompass brings symptoms, sleep, HRT and other medications, lab results, movement, weight, and notes into one private record. Check in quickly, review patterns across 7, 30, and 90 days, and create a clinician-ready report for your next appointment.

FAST DAILY TRACKING
• Log common menopause and perimenopause symptoms
• Record sleep, mood, hot flashes, night sweats, movement, weight, and notes
• Track HRT, medications, supplements, schedules, and doses
• Keep lab results alongside the rest of your timeline

CLEARER PATTERNS OVER TIME
See how symptoms and daily factors change across a week, month, or quarter. Personal summaries help you review your history without pretending that correlation proves a trigger or cause.

BETTER-PREPARED APPOINTMENTS
Create a structured report with your symptom trends, treatments, labs, and notes. Bring a clearer record to your clinician instead of trying to reconstruct months from memory.

EVIDENCE WITHOUT THE HYPE
Use an evidence-graded reference library covering menopause symptoms, treatment options, sleep, mood, sexual health, bone health, and more. Sources and uncertainty are shown clearly.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your health entries stay on your device. There is no account, cloud health database, sale of personal data, or third-party advertising. Limited app-performance and advertising-attribution data never includes your health entries. Local backup and restore keep you in control of your record.

ONE SUBSCRIPTION, EVERY FEATURE
MenoCompass requires an active auto-renewable monthly or annual subscription. There is no free tier or free trial. The exact price is shown before purchase, and payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple ID subscription settings.

Privacy Policy: https://menlopass.vercel.app/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://menlopass.vercel.app/terms.html

MenoCompass provides general health education and self-tracking. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, prescribe, or replace care from a qualified clinician.
en-US.releaseNotes: A faster daily check-in, polished onboarding, clearer subscription access, improved reliability, and privacy-safe performance and attribution updates.
